h1: Meta Ads vs Google Ads: Which Is Better for Small Businesses in India?
quickAnswer: Google Ads works best when people already search for what you sell — "dermatologist near me" or "CA firm in Hyderabad". Meta Ads (Instagram and Facebook) works best when you need to create demand with visuals — food, fashion, salons, events and offers. Most growing businesses use both: Google to capture intent, Meta to build it.

sections.heading: What is the core difference between Google Ads and Meta Ads?

blocks.text: Google Ads is intent-based. Your ad appears when someone types a search, so they already want a solution. Meta Ads is interest-based. Your ad appears in feeds, Reels and Stories for people who match an audience, whether or not they were looking today.
Think of Google as a shop on a busy street where people walk in asking for something. Meta is a stall at a crowded mall: people weren't looking for you, but a good display stops them.

sections.heading: When should you choose Google Ads?

blocks.text: Choose Google first when the need is urgent or specific and people actively look for it:

items: Home services: pest control, AC repair, interiors, packers and movers
Professional services: CA, legal, B2B software, IT services
Education searches such as "MBA colleges in Hyderabad"

blocks.text: If few people search for your category, Google will struggle to spend your budget well.

sections.heading: When should you choose Meta Ads?

blocks.text: Choose Meta first when your product sells on looks, emotion or an offer:

items: Salons, spas, fashion, jewellery and bridal services
D2C products, home foods, furniture and décor
Events, launches and new store openings

blocks.text: Meta also works for services people don't search for yet, such as a new nutrition program or an online course, because it lets you introduce the idea.

Meta usually has a lower cost per click and per thousand impressions, so it looks cheaper. But the right measure is cost per customer, not cost per click. A ₹40 Google click from someone searching "skin specialist in Jubilee Hills" can be worth more than five ₹8 clicks from Instagram scrollers. Track both channels to the sale or booking — using call tracking, WhatsApp tracking and Meta's Conversions API — before deciding.

sections.heading: How should you split the budget between them?

blocks.text: A practical starting split for local businesses:

items: High-intent services (clinics, professional services): 70% Google, 30% Meta retargeting.
Visual and offer-led businesses (restaurants, salons, D2C): 30% Google, 70% Meta.
New categories (new concept, new product): 20% Google, 80% Meta to build awareness first.

blocks.text: Review the split every month and move money to the channel with the lower cost per customer.

sections.heading: How do Google and Meta work together?

blocks.text: The strongest setup uses both in sequence. Meta Reels introduce your brand to people nearby. Some of them later search your name or category on Google — and your search ad and Google Business Profile catch them. Meanwhile, Meta retargeting reminds website visitors who didn't book. Each channel makes the other cheaper.

faqs.question: Are Facebook ads and Meta ads the same?
faqs.answer: Yes. Meta Ads Manager runs ads across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp and the Audience Network from one account.

faqs.question: What is the minimum budget for Google or Meta ads?
faqs.answer: There is no fixed minimum, but for local lead generation plan at least ₹500–₹1,000 a day per channel so the algorithms get enough data to optimise.

faqs.question: Which is better for B2B?
faqs.answer: Google Search and LinkedIn usually lead for B2B. Meta can work for retargeting and small-business buyers.

faqs.question: Can I run click-to-WhatsApp ads?
faqs.answer: Yes. Meta's click-to-WhatsApp ads open a chat directly, which suits Indian buyers who prefer messaging over forms.

faqs.question: Should an agency run my ads or can I do it myself?
faqs.answer: You can start yourself with small budgets. An agency adds value through creative testing, tracking setup and weekly optimisation, which usually lowers cost per lead.
